headline.en: Barcelona have seven Liga goals and none conceded heading into Rayo
headline.es: El Barca lleva siete goles a favor y cero en contra antes del Rayo

summary.en: Barcelona have scored seven Liga goals and conceded none after Elche and Athletic. Those two matches are not the same test. Rayo Vallecano defend in a low block and attack the channel behind the full-backs. Monday at 21:30 at Camp Nou is the first time this start will meet a side set up to sit in and wait for a mistake.
summary.es: Siete a favor y cero en contra. Elche y Athletic no son el mismo examen. El Rayo se cierra y ataca el pasillo. El lunes a las 21:30 es la primera prueba distinta.

body.en: Unbeaten and watertight is the table version. The film version is a team that has not yet been asked to break a parked defence for ninety minutes. Elche collapsed. Athletic tried to play and left space that Raphinha and Fermin used. Rayo will not offer that willingly. The left-back choice, the Gordon-or-Adeyemi choice and the question of whether Ferran starts as a closer reference all sit on that problem. Two from two can become two from three without the season changing. It can also expose whether the press Flick recovered from his first season works when the opponent refuses the press. That is the only reason to write this card. Not to celebrate seven goals. To name the first opponent who will try to cancel the method. If Barcelona still create chances against a low block, the start is real. If they recycle in front of the box for an hour, the Athletic night was a mirage. Monday is short enough to tell the difference.

headline.en: Flick has recovered the press from his first season. October is the test
headline.es: Flick ha recuperado la presion de su primera temporada. Octubre es la prueba

summary.en: Javier Gascon wrote in Mundo Deportivo that Flick has recovered the vertical, high-tempo press of his first season. The first two Liga matches have looked like that. In October Barcelona go to Galatasaray and Paris in consecutive weeks. The idea is already visible. The question is whether Raphinha, Pedri and Yamal have enough support around them when those weeks arrive.
summary.es: Gascon escribio que Flick ha recuperado la presion vertical del primer ano. Los dos primeros partidos se parecen a eso. En octubre visita a Galatasaray y al PSG.

body.en: Style pieces in week two are cheap unless they name the cost. The cost of this press is the same as it was in Flick's first autumn: hamstrings, yellow cards and a midfield that has to cover the jump. Rodri is still in the gym. Gavi missed Saturday. Pedri has started. Gordon can do the running Raphinha cannot do every third day. That is the support. If those pieces are fit in October, Gascon's comparison will look right. If they are not, Barcelona will play the same idea with fewer bodies and the first-season press will look like the first-season injuries. The UCL calendar is the exam paper. Liga nights against sides that sit in are the homework. Flick has the idea back. He does not yet have a midfield that can play it three times in eight days. That sentence is the whole card. Everything else is atmosphere.

headline.en: Yamal played an hour at Elche and 90 minutes against Athletic
headline.es: Yamal jugo una hora en Elche y 90 minutos ante el Athletic

summary.en: After Elche, Flick said Lamine Yamal had taken three weeks of holiday, trained for only a few days and still played about an hour while taking part in both goals. Against Athletic he played the full match and hit the post. Luis de la Fuente has already spoken about calling him back to the national team. The staff are increasing his minutes in stages.
summary.es: Flick dijo que Yamal venia de tres semanas de vacaciones y aun asi jugo cerca de una hora en Elche. Ante el Athletic completo el partido. De la Fuente ya habla de la seleccion.

body.en: The only useful way to write Yamal this weekend is as a minutes story. He created enough against Athletic to score and did not. He also went from a managed hour to a full match inside four days. That is the jump Flick has to watch, not the finishing. Spain will want him. Barcelona have Feyenoord on 9 September at 18:45. If those two calls stack on top of Rayo, the three-week holiday stops being context and starts being a warning. The club can live without a Liga goal from him in August. It cannot live with him unavailable in the first European fortnight because August was greedy. De la Fuente speaking already is not an attack on Flick. It is another claimant on the same legs. The staff can still keep the climb staged: Rayo at a controlled number, then Europe, then a rest when Spain come calling. That plan only works if someone writes it down as minutes rather than as vibes about a genius.
